outlook.statement: Your directors are making concentrated efforts to increase the turnover which will generate the more profitability and Company's growth.

The Company's immediate focus is on strengthening its core operations, improving revenue generation and maintaining effective control over operating costs. The Company intends to adopt a cautious and disciplined approach towards its operations and financial resources. Going forward, the Company will continue to assess business opportunities based on their commercial viability and potential contribution to sustainable growth.
